fusions.name: Shut Mouth
fusions.desc: Silences one enemy within 7 tiles for 3 seconds and deals 8 damage, taking its next action away and stunning it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Final Syllable
fusions.desc: Speaks a bolt that deals 14 damage to the first enemy it meets, uses up every affliction you have on it, and deals 60% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Rehearsed Cadence
fusions.desc: Increases your cast speed by 30% for 15 seconds. Your dodge chance rises by 10% while it holds.

fusions.name: Practiced Tempo
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner. Your armour rises by 8%.
